data.content:
I submitted the dispute for case ubereats:UE-tf03c for owner approval. It was accepted on the second try.

The first attempt was rejected because the wording checker flagged "lied". That string appeared inside the word "applied", so I changed it to "taken" and resubmitted.

The dispute cites two pieces of evidence: the order ticket lists Garlic Naan, and the order was ready at 20:33 and picked up at 20:36. It states that we have no evidence of what was in the bag after pickup. It asks for the $15.00 deduction to be reviewed and reversed.

I left out the repeat-claimant evidence (three claims from the same customer account in this period). Mentioning it risked reading as a characterisation of the customer.
